name: Kawasaki H2 Mach IV 750
engine: 748 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, CDI ignition, oil injection
intro: Kawasaki's wild 750 triple. Crank seals between the cylinders and the oil pump decide whether it survives.

add.title: Leak-down test the crankcase
add.instructions: Pressure test each crankcase. The center seals between cylinders can't be changed without pressing the crank apart.
add.reason: Dried-out crank seals are expected on triples that sat, and leaking seals make a cylinder run lean.

H: Have the crank rebuilt by a shop that knows Kawasaki triple cranks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Crank seals
known.what: Multi-cylinder two-strokes have seals between the cylinders that dry out with age.
